🏛️ CBLR Rule 6 Examination Instructions

Official NACIN / Regulation 6(7) Scheme

  • Exam Structure: 150 Multiple Choice Questions (Full Mock) based on the official 21 Regulation 6(7) chapters.
  • Total Marks & Duration: 450 Maximum Marks · 150 Minutes (2.5 hours).
  • Marking Scheme:
    • +3 Marks awarded for each correct answer.
    • -1 Mark penalty deducted for each wrong answer (negative marking).
    • 0 Marks for unattempted questions.
  • Qualifying Standard: Minimum 60% aggregate score (270 / 450 marks).

Question Palette Navigation & Color Coding (TCS iON Standard)

Answered (Green): Option chosen and saved. Evaluated in scoring.
Not Answered (Red): Question visited but no answer chosen.
Marked for Review (Purple): Flagged to revisit without an answer. Not evaluated.
Answered & Marked for Review (Purple with Green Dot): Answer chosen AND marked for review. Evaluated in final scoring under official rules!
Not Visited (White/Grey): Question not yet opened.
